dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Multiple thin, high-contrast pale horizontal bands are visible across the greater and median coverts, following the edges of individual feathers.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Distinct and sharply defined pale buff edges are visible along the folded primary and secondary feathers against the dark brown feather centers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A visible color transition exists where the uniform brownish-grey crown meets the high-contrast scaled pattern of the upper mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent black malar stripe extending from the base of the bill/eye area downwards, and a high-contrast white patch at the base of the upper mandible.
